maddeler.e:
أنكمش (form VII)
# أَنْكَمِشُ (ʔankamišu) /ʔan.ka.mi.ʃu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْكَمَشَ (inkamaša)
# أَنْكَمِشَ (ʔankamiša) /ʔan.ka.mi.ʃa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَمَشَ (inkamaša)
# أَنْكَمِشْ (ʔankamiš) /ʔan.ka.miʃ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْكَمَشَ (inkamaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
